newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers bounce up, spurs some short covering.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers bounce up, spurs some short covering.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers rose from Monday's lows, surprising a number of shipowners and bringing some demand, while bunkers in other areas were broadly steady, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST rose from $109 fob quoted in the morning to $111 in the afternoon. Suppliers said many shipowners had been expecting further weakness and the surprise rise led a number to cover small shortages. Demand totalled about 10,000 tonnes in ARA.
"We had quite a few enquiries, though mostly small ones, late in the morning as prices rose," a dealer said.
Hamburg prices were steady. The rise of Rotterdam prices, however, led to reasonable healthy demand.
"I guess the buyers feared prices are heading back up again," one dealer said.
Mediterranean prices were also stable. Spanish ports received a few enquiries, but most other areas were quiet. Dealers in many other ports said initial enquiries did not result in trades.
Fujairah bunkers were flat in line with the thin cargo market.
